question: Which country is the leading producer of coffee in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Brazil **is the** leading producer of coffee** in the world, producing almost **40%** of the world's coffee supply.
 
• Brazil's coffee industry is primarily made up of** small-scale farmers**, with around 300,000 coffee farms </strong
